title: A lattice path model for the volume of the Monge polytope
summary: Monge matrices arise throughout combinatorial optimization and algorithm design; the Monge polytope $\mathcal{M}_{pq}$ is the set of $p \times q$ Monge matrices lying inside the standard simplex on the set of matrix coordinates. We find a Stanley decomposition of the associated affine semigroup, and use it to obtain a volume formula for $\mathcal{M}_{pq}$ expressed as a sum over "Z-avoiding" Delannoy paths in a $p \times q$ grid. An efficient dynamic-programming implementation of this formula computes the volume in dimensions far beyond the reach of general-purpose exact-volume algorithms…
